In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the pion interferometry measurements are not yet able to provide evidence of thermalized matter at RHIC.
pion interferometry is a very powerful tool to study the properties of the QGP and the hadronic phase, but it cannot distinguish a QGP phase from a hadron-rescattering-dominated scenario.
